rows.title: Review loading starts immediately, stale invalidation reloads when visible, generation rejects older source requests, manual refresh feedback minimum 650 ms, source-specific empty/error states.
rows.baseline_behavior: Review loading starts immediately, stale invalidation reloads when visible, generation rejects older source requests, manual refresh feedback minimum 650 ms, source-specific empty/error states.
rows.baseline_edge_state: On an error after an existing snapshot, code keeps previous snapshot and only sets `review_error` if no snapshot exists. Selection/scroll and collapses are refreshed per mode. This cached-error behavior is source truth, not proof fresh content is shown.
rows.fixture: Temporary Git repository with differing HEAD/index/worktree/branch/turn snapshots, Unicode/quoted paths and complete/compact/binary patches.

steps.action: Open a Review source without cached data; manually refresh a loaded source; then change to another source while the first load is delayed.
steps.expected: Loading begins immediately; a source change resets unrelated snapshot. Completion for the obsolete generation cannot replace the selected source.

steps.action: Keep same-source snapshot on refresh error, show first-load error honestly and maintain minimum source refresh feedback timing.
steps.expected: On an error after an existing snapshot, code keeps previous snapshot and only sets `review_error` if no snapshot exists. Selection/scroll and collapses are refreshed per mode. This cached-error behavior is source truth, not proof fresh content is shown.

steps.action: Fail first Review collection; then load successfully and fail refreshing that same source.
steps.expected: First load shows unavailable/error rather than an empty-success diff. Same-source refresh preserves the previous snapshot with a visible error; failure is not cleared merely by navigating back.

steps.action: Complete a manually requested refresh in less than50ms using a controlled collector and clock; inspect refresh feedback at100ms,649ms and650ms.
steps.expected: Source refresh_from_button feedback remains active for at least650ms even when Git finishes immediately. A slow request stays loading until its actual completion; the time floor is not a fake completion delay for content.

steps.action: Run this row in two cloned fixture homes, baseline then Go. Record touched files and active state; relaunch both; repeat the action and compare restored/reset state.
steps.expected: Restore/reset behavior and file contents must match the pinned handler. In-memory-only state stays in-memory; persistence is not inferred from an available store helper. Apply the specific source state contract above.

steps.action: Focus Review and press Escape during load, then reopen and invoke the registered Refresh action.
steps.expected: Escape follows Review cancellation/focus behavior rather than sending agent abort. Refresh reloads the current source and keeps its source/ref/path selection.

steps.action: Queue sourceA, sourceB and sourceC refreshes; release callbacks in C,A,B order while also switching workspace.
steps.expected: Only current generation/workspace/session/source/ref/path can apply. If a pending request was deferred while loading, it runs once after stale completion rather than being lost.
